takeaway: The submandibular gland is separated from the parotid gland posteriorly by the stylomandibular ligament. Lingual nerve lies above it, hypoglossal below.

question.text: Which statement is correct regarding the anatomy of the submandibular gland?

answer.text: The gland is separated from the parotid gland by the stylomandibular ligament.

lines.text: Let us place the submandibular gland, at the angle of the jaw.
Far behind, the parotid gland sits in front of the ear.
The stylomandibular ligament runs between them, separating the two glands. That is our answer.
The lingual nerve lies superior to the submandibular gland.
The hypoglossal nerve lies inferior. Both are at risk during gland excision.
(clears throat) And the duct arises anteriorly, to open beside the frenulum.
